**CBSE Class 4 Mathematics Board Exam Analysis (Number System & Arithmetic)**

**1. Most-Tested Question Patterns:**
Expect multi-digit word problems involving all four operations, direct questions on Place Value and Face Value (up to lakhs), comparison and ordering of large numbers, and multi-digit addition/subtraction/multiplication (3-digit by 2-digit) and division with remainder. Number patterns, estimation/rounding (nearest 10, 100, 1000), and converting number names to numerals are also highly frequent.

**2. Difficulty Distribution:**
